column3: “sector” renders “side (pe’ah),” and “along the side of Edom” renders “on the hands of Edom.”
“the ascent of Akrabbim” renders “the ascent of scorpions,” and “its termination” renders “its goings out” (also in verses 5, 8–9 and 12).
“the brook of Egypt” renders “the wadi of Egypt.”
“draw your border line” renders “mark out (ta’u)” (also in verses 8 and 10).
“apportion by lot among you as a possession” renders “inherit by lot.”
“opposite Jericho” renders “of Jericho,” and “eastward toward the sunrising” renders the doubled “eastward, toward sunrise.”
“one leader of every tribe” renders “one leader, one leader from a tribe.”
